narration.text: Larkspur-4: 27 days of drilling. The well reached total depth on 27 March: 6 h behind plan, and 1.3 m deeper. Through the upper sections, drilling tracked the plan. In the last section it fell more than a day behind, then closed the gap to 6 h by total depth. 28.5 h were lost: 4.4% of the time. Rig equipment caused 15.5 h: the mud pump and top drive. Weather cost 8 h; a tight hole, 5 h. Spend is USD 9.83 million, within the 10.5 million budget. Next: confirm the liner bottom, 1.3 m below plan. Reconcile the final cost against the budget left. And watch rig equipment, the largest cause of lost time.
